events.verdict: Tatum (BOS) makes incidental high-five contact with Butler's (PHI) hand after he has released the ball.
Redick (PHI) makes contact with Morris's (BOS) arm and affects his driving shot attempt.
Irving (BOS) briefly grasps Chandler (PHI) before correcting.
Irving (BOS) wraps Chandler (PHI) in the post.
Horford (BOS) sets the pick in Butler's (PHI) path and does not prevent him from disengaging from the contact.
Smart (BOS) briefly grasps Redick (PHI) but does not prevent him from setting the screen.
Smart (BOS) briefly engages with Redick (PHI) but the contact is marginal.
[Observable in enhanced video] Redick (PHI) is in the paint for longer than three seconds.
Irving (BOS) makes marginal contact with Chandler's (PHI) body before Tatum (BOS) cleanly blocks his shot attempt near the rim.
Smart (BOS) is firming up in a legal picking position in Butler's (PHI) path and he absorbs contact.
Irving (BOS) makes marginal contact with Chandler's (PHI) arm during his drive that does not affect Chandler's ability to defend.
RAR shows Chandler (PHI) moves along Irving's (BOS) path and Irving jumps into him to create the contact on his driving shot attempt.
Butler (PHI) briefly grasps Irving (BOS) but does not affect his SQBR.
Irving (BOS) makes marginal contact with Butler (PHI) that does not affect his ability to defend during his drive.
Hayward (BOS) briefly grasps Simmons (PHI) but does not affect his FOM.
Hayward (BOS) legally contests Redick's (PHI) jump shot attempt.
Butler (PHI) and Morris (BOS) make incidental contact with one another off-ball.
Simmons (PHI) is in a legal picking position in Tatum's (BOS) path and he absorbs contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Embiid (PHI) is in the paint for longer than three seconds.
Hayward (BOS) legally contests Redick's (PHI) jump shot.
Tatum (BOS) holds Butler (PHI) and affects his SQBR.
Embiid (PHI) makes incidental foot contact with Tatum (BOS) that causes him to fall to the floor.
Hayward (BOS) makes incidental contact with Chandler's (PHI) body as he cleanly dislodges the ball.
RAR shows Redick (PHI) makes contact with Morris's (BOS) wrist and affects his shot attempt at the basket.
Hayward (BOS) is in the paint for longer than three seconds.
Butler (PHI) makes contact with Irving's (BOS) arm but does not prevent him from getting to the rebound.
Butler (PHI) makes marginal contact with Irving's (BOS) arm at the start of his drive.
LAR shows Horford (BOS) extends his forearm and initiates the contact to Simmons's (PHI) body that affects his driving shot attempt.
Chandler (PHI) commits a take foul on Tatum (BOS) after his gather.
Tatum (BOS) makes incidental high-five contact with Butler's (PHI) hand after he has released the ball.
LLB shows Smart (BOS) makes contact with the ball before he makes incidental contact with Chandler (PHI) during the loose ball situation.
Simmons (PHI) makes marginal contact with Tatum's (BOS) arm during his drive.
Redick (PHI) commits a take foul on Hayward (BOS).
